claim_ceiling: Descriptive characterization of dense embedding scale-dependence on 12k accepted sample (2000-2002). No product claims.
evidence_summary: 12k dense embeddings (multilingual-e5, center-projected) characterized at 7 scales (1k-12.5k) for cross-lingual alignment, legal area clustering, branch k-NN, and linear hybrid (8 weights) with TF-IDF baselines. Only NMI last-digit variance from K-means non-determinism. All metrics internally consistent, no leakage, no unsupported claims.
